notes.title: Major Updates
notes.content:
Some of the updates include:
[list]
[*] Voice chat
[*] You can see the number of times the player won in the current room
[*] The bots now move in patterns instead of moving randomly
[*] Some bugs were fixed
[*] Guests can now include their name
[/list]

notes.title: Bot Crisis Major Update! New Levels and other improvements!
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] New levels
[*] Fix connection issues
[*] The game rules have changed. Now each game has several rounds, and each player has several life points
[*] In-game shop
[*] New hats
[*] Add abilities
[*] Other improvements and fixes
[/olist]
